Paper textures in this folder are adapted from Subtle Patterns (https://www.toptal.com/designers/subtlepatterns/),
originally collected at github.com/subtlepatterns/SubtlePatterns, by Atle Mo and the original pattern authors.

Licensed under Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/).
Changes: converted to greyscale and evened out around mid-grey so they can be blended over any page colour.
These adapted textures are shared under the same license.

  fine.webp      <- paper_fibers.png
  book.webp      <- extra_clean_paper.png
  laid.webp      <- paper.png
  rice.webp      <- ricepaper2.png
  handmade.webp  <- lightpaperfibers.png
  recycled.webp  <- exclusive_paper.png
  natural.webp   <- natural_paper.png
  linen.webp     <- low_contrast_linen.png
  felt.webp      <- felt.png
  card.webp      <- black_paper.png
